court_name: Superior Court of California, County of San Mateo
case_search_note: Odyssey Public Portal (no registration), linked from sanmateo.courts.ca.gov/online-services/online-case-access/odyssey-portals. Shows the register of actions for non-confidential, non-sealed criminal cases; criminal case DOCUMENTS are not viewable online (documents only for civil, family, probate, small claims, traffic). Juvenile and mental health cases are not online. MIDX index search by case number/party/filing date: https://web.sanmateocourt.org/midx. Traffic payments also through the Odyssey portal.

courthouses.name: Southern Branch: Hall of Justice and Records
courthouses.hours: Criminal Division office and phone: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (Criminal Division, 4th Floor). Other clerk offices in the building have different, shorter in-person hours.
courthouses.note: Main criminal courthouse: felony and misdemeanor calendars, collaborative courts, plus civil, family, probate, small claims, records. Criminal Division fax (650) 261-5050. Departments with a criminal or collaborative assignment from the Directory of Judges as of 2026-10-13; several other trial departments (Depts. 1, 9, 12, 14, 16, 22, 24) are listed only as 'Trial Judge' without saying civil or criminal. Assignments rotate.

programs.name: Probation Pretrial Services (O.R. / Supervised O.R.)
programs.summary: Probation investigates people booked into jail and gives the judge a release/non-release recommendation at the in-custody arraignment (O.R., supervised O.R., bail adjustment, or stay in custody). People on supervised/conditional O.R. must stay in regular personal and phone contact with a Pretrial officer; monitoring depends on the court's conditions (e.g., drug testing for substance charges). Officers report compliance to the court.

programs.name: Drug Court (incl. Prop 36 (2024))
programs.summary: Substance abuse recovery program for eligible defendants. Directory of Judges lists Drug Court/Prop 36 review in Dept. 25.

programs.name: Military Diversion
programs.summary: Pretrial program for current or past members of any military branch charged with a misdemeanor. Dept. 8.

programs.name: Pathways (Mental Health Court)
programs.summary: Mental health treatment court that can also provide drug and alcohol treatment and housing help. Dept. 13.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: Special court for U.S. military veterans in the criminal justice system. Dept. 8.

programs.name: Multiple DUI Court
programs.summary: Post-plea court for eligible repeat DUI offenders. Participant handbook on the court site; Spanish copy by request to collabcourts@sanmateocourt.org. Dept. 25.

programs.name: Mental Health Diversion Court
programs.summary: Listed in the Directory of Judges as an assignment of Dept. 25.

programs.name: Sheriff's Alternative Sentencing Bureau (Work Program, Electronic Monitoring, Work Furlough)
programs.summary: Sheriff's Work Program lets low-risk, minimum-security sentenced people serve time doing manual work instead of full-time jail; also electronic monitoring and work furlough. No program fees since July 1, 2021. 1300 Maple Street, Redwood City.

programs.name: Self-Help Center / Family Law Facilitator
programs.summary: Free legal information for people without lawyers (mainly family law, restraining orders). Hall of Justice, 400 County Center, 6th Floor; contact by LiveChat on the court page before coming in.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — look up a bail agent's license status. San Mateo County Sheriff: to post cash bail, bring the amount to the cashier's window in the jail lobby (Sheriff Inmate Bail FAQ); the Sheriff is prohibited by law from referring bail agencies. Court bail schedules: sanmateo.courts.ca.gov/divisions/criminal-division/local-bail-schedules.
